nom: Lancôme Génifique Ultimate Eye Cream with Beta Glucan-CM

segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports it does not bother her under-eyes at all; by contrast, several reviewers who say they do not normally have sensitive skin or have never reacted to any product before report severe reactions, including drying, cracking, flaking, rash, and swelling around the eyes, with one suspecting the fragrance, unlike the fragrance-free product she switched from, may be the cause.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes it working great on her 67-year-old skin and says she'll stick with it as her favorite.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visibly fewer fine lines, wrinkles, and less morning puffiness with regular use, with some saying they need less concealer and look younger than their age; one reviewer, however, reports no visible difference at all and finds it overpriced compared to a cheaper alternative she prefers.
concerns.dehydration: Reports on dryness are sharply split and serious: three reviewers describe severe, persistent drying, cracking, and flaking around the eyes lasting days to weeks, even after just one or two applications; several other reviewers, including one using it for a couple of years, report no drying at all and say it specifically resolved their dry under-eye area.
concerns.barrier: Three reviewers, all of whom say they do not normally react to skincare products, report serious reactions specifically around the eyes: one developed a rash, swelling lasting a week, and discharge severe enough to require a dermatologist visit; another woke up with crusty, irritated eyes; and a third had cracked, flaky, slightly puffy skin under one eye.
concerns.spots: One reviewer who started with moderate dark circles reports her eyes look noticeably brighter and require less concealer, though she does not explicitly say the dark circles themselves faded.

aspects.libelle: Very expensive relative to results for some
Formula seems unchanged despite name change to Ultimate
Rich, thick consistency, a little goes a long way

extraits.titre: Zero stars, Worst eye cream ever, be careful!!!
extraits.texte: I never write negative reviews, but I don't want this cream to harm anyone else's skin. My skin has never been sensitive and I have never had a reaction to any product. But this is horrible, I ordered it with high expectations but it was my mistake not to read the reviews before. Not only did it dry out my skin around my eyes, I also had a rash around my eyes and face, I had swelling in my eyes for a week and discharge. I only used it for two days giving it a chance but it was the worst thing I did. I had to go to the dermatologist. Please DO NOT buy this, stay away from this eye cream. Ulta was kind enough to give me a refund, but I'm still dealing with dry skin around my eyes after weeks.

I used this for two days and my eyes felt like I had sand in them. I would wake up with super crusty and very irritated eyes, I did not apply it too close to my eyelids. Avoid this if you have sensitive/dry eyes!!!

Like the other review mentioned, this eye cream dried my skin underneath my eye out really bad. So bad, my skin was cracked, flakey and a little puffy due to the irritation. I never applied on my upper lid, just underneath lower lash line but not close to my lower lash line. I have never had any reaction to any skin products before. I switched from using a fragrance free eye cream to try this product, which does contain fragrance. So my guess is that the fragrance may be the irritant possibly. Bummed. Lancome has always been known for their great products, but this will not be a brand I purchase again.

Thus product is extremely pricey and doesn't live up to it's price point. For the price it should glide on like butter and my skin should sigh a sign if relief and say "oh thank you..." , like it does when i use my Kiehl's Eye Treatment, which is 2/3 of the price of Lancome. I saw and felt no visible difference whatsoever.
I like this eye cream. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't bother my under eyes.
I was recommended by two friends and I am happy I took their advice. It works great on my 67 year old skin. It's my favorite and I will stick with it.

I bought this as a birthday gift to myself this year and I will absolutely repurchase it when it runs out. I noticed a difference within a few days and the skin around my eyes has never looked better. I'm 39 years old and only have mild wrinkles/crow's feet and moderate dark circles. I don't need nearly as much concealer, my eyes look so much brighter and the skin is plump and healthy. The consistency is thick, a little goes a long way, and it sits beautifully under makeup. I think this will be a staple in my skincare routine for years to come.

reserve: With only 13 of 20 reviews available and several describing severe reactions around the eyes, including one requiring a dermatologist visit, this is a small sample for judging how common these reactions are, and they do not appear limited to people who identify as having sensitive skin.
